roadmap.title: Spring: first rescues and daily systems
roadmap.description: April to June. Rescue Yukiko and Kanji, and knock out the one-off town and battle tasks that only need the early game.

roadmap.title: Summer to autumn: dungeons, fusion and grinds
roadmap.description: July to November. Clear Rise's, Mitsuo's and Naoto's dungeons, unlock big fusions, and grind battle counts, cards and Social Links.

roadmap.title: Winter: the True Ending
roadmap.description: December to March. Finish Nanako's, Adachi's and Marie's dungeons, defeat Izanami, and wrap up books, exams and the last Social Links.

roadmap.title: New Game+: collections and bosses
roadmap.description: Second playthrough. Do Margaret, Izanagi-no-Okami, the full Compendium and Rise's 250 lines, then earn Golden Completed.

achievements.summary: Earn every other achievement in the game.

steps.text: Unlock the other 49 achievements; this one pops when the last is done.

achievements.summary: Finish Yukiko Amagi's dungeon to rescue her.

steps.text: Clear Yukiko's dungeon in the @loc{TV World} before April 29. It unlocks when the dungeon ends.

achievements.summary: Finish Kanji Tatsumi's dungeon to rescue him.

steps.text: Clear Kanji's dungeon in the @loc{TV World}. It unlocks when the dungeon ends.

achievements.summary: Finish Rise Kujikawa's dungeon to rescue her.

steps.text: Clear Rise's dungeon in the @loc{TV World}. It unlocks when the dungeon ends.

achievements.summary: Finish Mitsuo Kubo's dungeon to secure him.

steps.text: Clear Mitsuo's dungeon in the @loc{TV World}. It unlocks when the dungeon ends.

achievements.summary: Finish Naoto Shirogane's dungeon to rescue her.

steps.text: Clear Naoto's dungeon in the @loc{TV World}. It unlocks when the dungeon ends.

achievements.summary: Finish Nanako Dojima's dungeon to rescue her.

steps.text: Clear Nanako's dungeon in the @loc{TV World}. It unlocks when the dungeon ends.

achievements.summary: Finish Tohru Adachi's dungeon without pushing Namatame into the TV.

guide.context: Do the earlier story steps for the True Ending route. Finishing Adachi's dungeon early skips ahead to December 23 and costs you days you need for Social Links.

steps.text: On December 3 in the evening, at @mechanic{Namatame's Punishment}, pick these six choices in order for the True Ending. First \"Wait a second here...\". Next \"We're missing something.\". Then \"Namatame's true feelings.\". After that \"Something's bothering me.\". Then \"We're missing something...\". Last, \"Calm the hell down!\".
Clear Adachi's dungeon in the @loc{TV World}. It unlocks when the dungeon ends.

achievements.summary: Finish Marie's dungeon to rescue her.

guide.context: Marie's dungeon only appears on the True Ending route, so skipping these steps locks the achievement for this playthrough.

steps.text: Finish the Aeon (Marie) Social Link by December 24, or before Adachi's dungeon ends.
On New Year's Day, enter the @loc{Velvet Room}, ask about Marie's whereabouts, and choose to save her.
When her dungeon event starts, clear Marie's dungeon in the @loc{TV World}.

achievements.summary: Defeat Izanami on the True Ending route.

guide.context: This needs the True Ending route, which depends on the December 3 Namatame choices and the March 20 elevator choice.

steps.text: On March 20, do not go home. Inspect the elevator at @loc{Junes} one more time and choose to investigate more.
Clear the last dungeon in the @loc{TV World} and defeat @enemy{Izanami}.

achievements.summary: Perform 50 Persona fusions.

steps.text: In the @loc{Velvet Room}, fuse Personas 50 times. Any fusion method and repeat fusions count.

achievements.description: Use 4 or more Personas in a special fusion
achievements.summary: Perform a special fusion that uses 4 or more Personas.

steps.text: From July 10 on, fuse in the @loc{Velvet Room} using a special fusion that takes 4 or more Personas.

achievements.summary: Experience a fusion accident.

guide.context: A fusion accident is a low-chance result of any fusion, at any point in the game. Igor fumbles the tarot cards when it happens.

steps.text: Save before you enter the @loc{Velvet Room}.
Fuse Personas. If no accident happens, reload the save and fuse again so you do not waste money.

achievements.description: Buy a Persona from the Compendium.
achievements.summary: Buy a Persona from the Compendium.

steps.text: In the @loc{Velvet Room}, open the Compendium and buy any Persona.

achievements.summary: Register a Skill Card.

guide.context: You get skill cards from Shuffle Time after battles or from the coffee you drink at @loc{Chagall Cafe}, found in Okina City.

steps.text: Win a card from Shuffle Time, then register it.

achievements.summary: Register 100 Skill Cards.

guide.context: Shuffle Time can give many cards in one TV World trip. @loc{Chagall Cafe} gives only one a day. Registered cards carry into New Game+.

steps.text: Collect skill cards from Shuffle Time in the @loc{TV World}.
Register cards until you have registered 100.

achievements.summary: Switch Personas 5 times in a single battle.

guide.context: You can switch once per turn, and you need at least 2 Personas.

steps.text: In one battle, switch Persona on 5 turns. The Personas do not need to be different.

achievements.summary: Hear 250 of Rise's navigation lines.

guide.context: Best done on New Game+. At least 350 lines exist, so expect to miss many. Only lines with on-screen text and voice count. Lines from opening an enemy's analysis window by hand do not count.

steps.text: Avoid unneeded fights before Rise joins on August 1 so you stay low level and strong enemies keep appearing. Keep Rise at Social Link rank 1 until you have enough strong-enemy lines.
Use analysis shuffling: analyze an enemy, back out, and repeat to trigger more game-state lines in the same turn. Only the first line of a turn normally plays.

Trigger lines by enemy count and attack type (preempt, normal, ambush), reinforcements, enemies left, summoned enemies, status ailments and stat drops on your party, knocking down or defeating 2 to 4 enemies with one character without ending the fight, and weaknesses or immunities Rise finds at battle start.
Trigger per-character lines for kills, criticals, weakness hits, low health, dying, dodging, being knocked down, victory and escaping, plus Golden Hand, Reaper, Rush Mode and boss lines.
Keep your first three party members until you have most of their lines, then rotate to the next three, and track the lines you hear until you reach 250.

achievements.summary: Deal more than 999 damage with one attack.

steps.text: Use @item{Power Charge} before a physical attack or @item{Mind Charge} before a magic attack. Area skills work best late in the game.

achievements.summary: Perform 50 All-Out Attacks.

steps.text: Knock down every enemy in a battle, then start an All-Out Attack. Repeat until you have done 50.

achievements.summary: Exploit enemy weaknesses 100 times.

steps.text: Hit enemies with attacks they are weak to until you reach 100. Rise at Social Link rank 2 or higher and analysis help find weaknesses.

achievements.summary: Get 50 Sweep Bonuses in Shuffle Time.

guide.context: A Sweep Bonus means drawing every card in Shuffle Time. Weakness hits and All-Out Attacks raise the chance of Shuffle Time. After a Sweep Bonus, Shuffle Time is guaranteed after your next non-boss battle and you start with 3 draws.

steps.text: Win battles until Shuffle Time starts.
Pick cards that give extra draws first, starting with those that give more than +1 draw. Then pick +1 cards that do not change other cards.
Draw every card to get a Sweep Bonus. Repeat until you have 50.

achievements.summary: Defeat a Golden Hand.

guide.context: Golden Hands appear now and then. They are tough and run away fast.

steps.text: Find a Golden Hand and defeat it before it flees.

achievements.displayName: One Who Has Proven Their Power
achievements.summary: Defeat Margaret in Nanako's dungeon.

guide.context: This needs New Game+ on the True Ending route, and you must finish Margaret's Empress Social Link at rank 10. Also beat the mini-bosses of the Yukiko, Kanji, Rise, Naoto, Mitsuo and Nanako dungeons before Adachi's dungeon ends. Margaret is very hard.

steps.text: Reach the last day. After Igor gives you the @item{Orb of Sight} and you leave the @loc{Velvet Room}, go back in to see a scene with Margaret.
Continue to the @loc{TV World}. Before Izanami's dungeon, enter Nanako's dungeon (Heaven).
Climb to the top floor and defeat @enemy{Margaret}.

achievements.summary: Defeat the Reaper.

guide.context: Aim for level 70 or higher. After you open 21 chests, you hear rattling, and the next shaking red chest may start the fight. The count carries across dungeons. It resets if you leave the dungeon, change floors, or open the 22nd chest without the Reaper.

steps.text: In Yukiko's dungeon, open chests until your counter reaches 20.
Go to floor 5 and open its 2 chests, which have a high encounter rate, until the Reaper appears.
Defeat @enemy{The Reaper}.

achievements.summary: Finish Aiya's special dish.

steps.text: Raise Courage, Diligence, Knowledge and Understanding to their maximum.
On a rainy day, eat at @loc{Aiya} in the Shopping District North and finish the special dish.

achievements.summary: Read every book in the game.

guide.context: Book Store books are bought on set dates. The rest come from quests and events listed below.

steps.text: April 20 at the Book Store: The Lovely Man, Expert Study Methods, Beginner Fishing. May 6: Off Today, Office Work Manual. May 20: Easy Origami, English Made Easy. June 11: Forever Macho; 100 Ghost Stories; and Catching Bugs. June 28: Short on Cash, Expert Fishing.

July 15 at the Book Store: Man of History, Home Gardening. August 4: Changing Careers, Hyperspeed Reading. August 24: Man-God, Food Fight!. September 20: Sensei's Friend. October 12: Farewell to Man. November 1: The Final Lesson, World Class Bugs.
The Ramen Way: you get it after your 8th meal at @loc{Aiya}.

Avid Reader quests: The Gentle Way (quest 18) needs a Peach Seed from a dungeon chest. The Punk's Way (quest 20) needs you to feed fish to the cat on the left of @loc{Samegawa Floodplain}. Guide to Pests (quest 34) needs the Hard Boots, bought from Daidara after you sell 5 Thick Hides dropped by Dancing Hand enemies (Kanji's dungeon, floor 5). Picross Rules! (quest 40) needs 3 Fashionable Dishes from Sky Balance enemies on floor 10 of Rise's dungeon. Who Am I? (quest 45): give four answers in this order: "Judo Medalists' Names." first; second, the option that begins "How one should" and ends "live as a punk."; third, "2 pages per pest."; last, "Me."

Event books: Witch Detective on May 29 and Poly-land on July 15 both come from Strength Social Link invitations in your room (July 17 event: choose the allergic response). These are missing if you chose Ichigo for Strength, so pick Daisuke. The O-Cha Way comes from the invitation on August 10. The Divine Way comes from saying yes when a girl asks you to the summer festival on August 21.

achievements.description: Buy an item from the Capsule Machine.
achievements.summary: Buy any item from the Capsule Machine.

steps.text: On a rainy day or night, use the @loc{Capsule Machine} outside Shiroku Store and buy an item.

achievements.description: Win a prize from the vending machine.
achievements.summary: Win a prize from a vending machine.

steps.text: In the Shopping District North, use a vending machine. Each try has a 50% chance to win. Save first and reload until you win.

achievements.description: Buy 5 things from Tanaka's Amazing Commodities.
achievements.summary: Buy 5 items from Tanaka's Amazing Commodities.

guide.context: The TV shopping show is available from May 3. You can buy one item per week, and stock resets on Sundays.

steps.text: Turn on Tanaka's show on your room TV and buy one item each week until you own 5 of them.

achievements.description: Buy a special croquette from Sozai Daigaku.
achievements.summary: Buy the special croquette from Sozai Daigaku.

steps.text: Wait for rain, then visit @loc{Sozai Daigaku} (Shopping District North) and buy the special croquette.

achievements.summary: Make 5 perfect boxed lunches.

guide.context: You can cook on nights when Nanako says she bought groceries. Picking the right instruction makes the lunch perfect.

steps.text: When Nanako mentions fresh groceries at night, choose to cook the next day's lunch.

For each dish, pick the matching instruction. Wrap it tightly = Broiled Fish. Add soy sauce and mirin = Carrot & Burdock Root Kinpira. Thinned eggs = Chakin Sushi. Dump in all the cold milk = Cream Stew. High simmer = Croquettes Curry. Deep fry them = Daigaku-Imo. Potato starch = Fried Chicken and also Sweet & Sour Pork. Score it with a knife = Ginger Pork. Strong heat but from far away = Grilled Fish. Olive oil = Gyoza.

More dishes. Cut a hole and check for juice = Hamburgers. Mirin, sugar and sake = Kakuni. Strain it = Marinated Spinach. Simmer with a dropped lid = Meat Stew. Mayonnaise = Mentaiko Pasta. Low flame, no boiling = Oden. Smash while still hot = Potato Salad. Vanilla extract = Pudding. Flour, egg, then panko = Tonkatsu. Add lots of milk = Vichyssoise. Use soy sauce = Yakiniku Bento. Mix and cool simultaneously = California Rolls.
Repeat until you have made 5 perfect lunches.

achievements.description: Enter a special relationship with someone.
achievements.summary: Enter a romantic relationship with someone.

guide.context: Only one is needed. High-school girl Social Links offer it at later ranks.

steps.text: Raise a girl's Social Link until the relationship option appears, then accept it.

achievements.summary: Reach the maximum rank in all social stats.

steps.text: Raise Knowledge, Courage, Diligence, Understanding and Expression to rank 5.

achievements.summary: Obtain the Persona Izanagi.

steps.text: Play through the story; you get Izanagi automatically.

achievements.summary: Fuse the Persona Izanagi-no-Okami.

guide.context: You need a New Game+ made from a save that finished the True Ending. Izanagi-no-Okami appears only in the last fight with Izanami.

steps.text: On New Game+, reach level 95 after July 20 with all 12 Persona slots free.
Hold these Personas at the same time: Izanagi, Sandman, Nata Taishi, Girimehkala, Norn, Okuninushi, Orthrus, Kartikeya, Mithra, Tzitzimitl, Cu Chullain and Legion.
In the @loc{Velvet Room}, pick the Dodecagon special fusion and make @item{Izanagi-no-Okami}.

achievements.summary: Register more than 50% of the Persona Compendium.

steps.text: Fuse or draw Personas and register them until the Compendium shows over 50% complete.

achievements.summary: Complete the Persona Compendium.

guide.context: Izanagi-no-Okami does not count. Some top-tier Personas need a maxed Social Link, but on the last day in the @loc{TV World}, a level 93 character can fuse them all. The Compendium carries into New Game+.

steps.text: Register every Persona through fusion or Shuffle Time.
Use a fusion calculator to plan the missing ones until the Compendium reaches 100%.

achievements.summary: Fight a battle while wearing a costume.

steps.text: Equip any costume you got from the story, then enter a battle.

achievements.description: Rank #1 in your class on an exam.
achievements.summary: Rank first in your class on an exam.

guide.context: Five exams exist, but only the first four count.

steps.text: Max out Knowledge, then answer every exam question correctly.

achievements.summary: Catch the Sea Guardian while fishing.

steps.text: Give the boy at the shrine gate a soda to get a Tatsuhime Ladybug, or catch one with the bug net.
At night, trade the ladybug to the lady at @loc{Shiroku Store} for a fishhook. You may need a gem in your bag to see the option.
Take the fishhook to the elderly man at @loc{Samegawa Riverside}.
Fish at @loc{Shichiri Beach}. Use a Genji Beetle as bait (you can buy it in a combo on the TV shopping channel) on December 20 and look for several ripples with splashes, then catch the Sea Guardian.

achievements.summary: Reach rank 10 in any one Social Link.

steps.text: Spend time with one character until their Social Link reaches the maximum rank.

achievements.summary: Reach rank 10 in 10 Social Links.

steps.text: Max out Social Links until you have 10 at rank 10.

achievements.summary: Reach rank 10 in every Social Link.

guide.context: Keep a Persona of the matching Arcana equipped when you meet a Social Link to earn bonus points. Hermit, Fool, Empress, Star, Judgement, and Jester from rank 6 do not need it. A day-by-day schedule is the safest way to max them all.

steps.text: Follow a Social Link schedule so you can max every link before the end.

For the Empress (Margaret) link, bring a Persona with the listed skill each rank: Ippon-Datara with Sukukaja (rank 2), Matador with Mahama (3), Gdon with Rampage (4), Neko Shogun with Bufula (5), Black Frost with Auto-Sukukaja (6), Yatagarasu with Megido (7), Yatsufusa with Mediarama (8), Ganesha with Tetrakarn (9), Trumpeter with Mind Charge (10).

achievements.description: Drink the coffee at Chagall Café.
achievements.summary: Drink the coffee at Chagall Cafe.

steps.text: Go to Okina City, enter @loc{Chagall Cafe}, and drink the coffee.

achievements.summary: Watch 3 movies at 30 Frame.

steps.text: Go to the theater in Okina City and watch a movie, three times.

achievements.description: Swing the net with perfect timing.
achievements.summary: Swing the bug net with perfect timing.

steps.text: After June 4, the boy at the shrine gate asks you to find his bug net.
Go to the shrine at night until a lady in white gives you the net.
Swing the net at a tree the moment the exclamation mark and sound cue appear.

achievements.description: Enter a battle with Player Advantage.
achievements.summary: Start a battle with Player Advantage.

steps.text: Hit a Shadow from behind in the dungeon.

achievements.description: Visit Nanako in the hospital 3 times
achievements.summary: Go to the hospital to see Nanako three separate times.

guide.context: The hospital is at the bus stop in Shopping District South. Visits do not change the story, so reload afterwards.

steps.text: On November 22, talk to Yosuke in Classroom 2-2, then go to the hospital and visit Nanako.
On November 23, talk to Chie in the Shopping District North, then visit Nanako at the hospital.
On November 24, talk to Rise on the Classroom Building 1st floor, then visit Nanako at the hospital.

achievements.summary: Win the Miracle Quiz Finals.

guide.context: The questions are obscure, so look up answers. Alt-tabbing right after a question does not pass time.

steps.text: From August 13, choose Inaba Public Access on the TV and win the Miracle Quiz prelims.
On November 28, play the finals. Answer: Italian food; Geometric shapes; Khufu; Atlas; Bridal; A cuckoo; No country; The Fibonacci sequence; Namib; Mochi.
